title: British Company Faces 1500% Surge in Software Bill
seoTitle: 1500% Surge in Software Bill for UK Firm
subtitle: A client reports an exorbitant increase in monthly fees for an accounting tool
excerpt: A UK user describes a 1500% spike in their monthly Harvest software bill, jumping from $130 to $2,110.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A British client, identified as Richard Haldenby, reported that his average monthly payment for Harvest software skyrocketed from $130 (approximately £95.50) to $2,110. This hike represents a 1500% increase over the previous price.

With information from BBC News.
